title: Spacing and a withheld position test the spatial inverse
question: When does a second spatial sample add stable information, and can a withheld sample expose phase drift?
finding: Near-degenerate spacing amplifies bounded noise; a two-point fit hides channel-specific phase drift that a withheld third point reveals.

failedControls.outcome: consistent; not falsely treated as channel mismatch

limits: One-dimensional known-c model and common phase reference assumed
Half-wavelength singular cases are not inverted
A third sample can reject this mismatch but cannot certify every physical assumption
Noise direction is constructed worst case; not a phone error distribution
